name: Isometric Neck Press
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed and head stacked neutrally over your spine.
Place your palm against your forehead and gently press your head forward into your hand without letting your head move.
Hold steady pressure while breathing calmly, then repeat the isometric hold against the back of your head.
Finish by pressing smoothly against the right side and then the left side of your head with your hand resisting equally.
tips: Keep your head completely motionless and use moderate, pain-free pressure rather than straining maximally.
Keep your jaw relaxed and breathe steadily throughout every isometric hold.
